text:
Priya Rao: merged a tiny config-only change that flips an internal feature flag. No customer-visible behavior. Do we bump patch?

Tom Becker: If no ABI/API change, prefer to avoid semver bump. But we need a way to mark the artifact so downstream CI that pins full tags can still find it.

releasebot: diff-type=config-only; tests=all green; last-tag=v2.3.7; suggested-action=emit-buildmeta-tag-if-annotated.

Priya Rao: Thoughts on using buildmeta tags like v2.3.7+meta.20260324 to represent such runs?

Tom Becker: Yes. Convention: config-only -> no semver increment. If downstream requires a distinct artifact, PR author adds annotation `release: metadata-patch` and releasebot will create vMAJ.MIN.PATCH+meta.TIMESTAMP.

infra-bot: rollout=canary 5% 10m; auto-rollback=enabled; tag-parsing=note: some tools ignore buildmeta. Recommend updating tools to parse core semver + meta.

Priya Rao: I'll add the annotation to the PR for now and open a tiny PR to releasebot to implement the flag. Also add a line to RELEASE_PROCESS.md.

Tom Becker: Add a changelog line under "meta/infra" for these tags: one-liner. Avoid promoting them to main release notes.

Priya Rao: sounds good, holding merge until releasebot change lands. :+1:
